claims.scope: Shoyu koji is defined as koji mold cultivated on processed soybeans, or soybeans with grains such as wheat or rice.
Saishikomi shoyu uses approximately equal soybean and wheat inputs for shoyu koji, and its moromi uses kiage instead of brine.
